normalized_matching_profile.description: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Private pool *Pool heating is available from October 1st through May 1st for an additional fee of $35 per day.- 5 adult bikes- 6-passenger LSV - 1 Minute bike ride to Seaside- Firepit- Fireplace- 2 Full kitchens- Complete Clean Linen Participant - All linens, including comforter covers, and laundered upon every checkout.DETAILS: Welcome to Sea Sparrow, a lovely Seagrove Beach home that sleeps 10 with 5 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms. With a beautiful backyard designed for relaxing in the Florida sun and a convenient location, this 2-story home will charm! Bike over to Seaside for dining and shopping, relax by the private pool, or stroll down to the beach—only a 6-minute walk away.Splashes of color, patterns, and natural materials combine to create a gorgeous coastal retreat throughout this delightful property. The fun begins in the screened front porch featuring cushioned patio chairs, a porch swing, and 2-person dinette set. Inside, hardwood floors and shiplap walls span the inviting first-floor great room. In the living area, 4 armchairs and a soft, white couch offer seating around the Smart TV and fireplace. Culinary creation is a delight in the stunning kitchen, equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and Spring-green cabinetry. Adjacent is a 6-person table, with additional seating available at the 3-stool bar. Head outside to the dreamy yard, boasting a crystal-clear private pool and 2 pastel-hued sun loungers, shaded by a pink resort-style umbrella. Enjoy peaceful afternoons drinking lemonade on the covered patio, outfitted with a 6-person alfresco table and grill. At nightfall, cozy up by the stylish firepit for s’mores and stories. An outdoor shower and laundry closet make post-beach clean-up a breeze. For bedtime, there are 2 colorful bedrooms on this level—1 guest bedroom with a queen bed and 1 primary bedroom with a king bed.Upstairs, guests will find 2 guest bedrooms with 1 king bed and 2 twin beds, respectively.The connected Carriage House is perfect for couples with a full kitchen, 2-person dining table, a private bathroom, couch, TV, sleeping nook with a king bed, and a private entrance.Experience a blissful Seagrove Beach getaway at Sea Sparrow! Easily explore thanks to parking for up to 6 vehicles, plus 5 complimentary adult bikes. For the nearest beach access, take Dogwood Street to East County Highway 30A, turn left, and Dogwood-Thyme Beach Access will be on the right. DETAILS: Welcome to Sea Sparrow, a lovely Seagrove Beach home that sleeps 10 with 5 bedrooms and 4.5 bathrooms. With a beautiful backyard designed for relaxing in the Florida sun and a convenient location, this 2-story home will charm! Bike over to Seaside for dining and shopping, relax by the private pool, or stroll down to the beach—only a 6-minute walk away. Splashes of color, patterns, and natural materials combine to create a gorgeous coastal retreat throughout this delightful property. The fun begins in the screened front porch featuring cushioned patio chairs, a porch swing, and 2-person dinette set. Inside, hardwood floors and shiplap walls span the inviting first-floor great room. In the living area, 4 armchairs and a soft, white couch offer seating around the Smart TV and fireplace. Culinary creation is a delight in the stunning kitchen, equipped with top-of-the-line appliances and Spring-green cabinetry. Adjacent is a 6-person table, with additional seating available at the 3-stool bar. Head outside to the dreamy yard, boasting a crystal-clear private pool and 2 pastel-hued sun loungers, shaded by a pink resort-style umbrella. Enjoy peaceful afternoons drinking lemonade on the covered patio, outfitted with a 6-person alfresco table and grill. At nightfall, cozy up by the stylish firepit for s’mores and stories. An outdoor shower and laundry closet make post-beach clean-up a breeze. For bedtime, there are 2 colorful bedrooms on this level—1 guest bedroom with a queen bed and 1 primary bedroom with a king bed. Upstairs, guests will find 2 guest bedrooms with 1 king bed and 2 twin beds, respectively. The connected Carriage House is perfect for couples with a full kitchen, 2-person dining table, a private bathroom, couch, TV, sleeping nook with a king bed, and a private entrance. Experience a blissful Seagrove Beach getaway at Sea Sparrow! Easily explore thanks to parking for up to 6 vehicles, plus 5 complimentary adult bikes. For the nearest beach access, take Dogwood Street to East County Highway 30A, turn left, and Dogwood-Thyme Beach Access will be on the right. Book today!
